explication: This repository supplies manga-source extensions for Komikku, Mihon, Tachiyomi, and compatible apps. The main workflow is app-initiated source browsing or search, retrieval of manga details and chapters, then page/image loading. Source adapters implement site-specific behavior; shared core and multisource modules provide networking and reusable site-family support. The README also describes catalogues and improved Suggestions support. Sampled source shows several specialized paths, but not the implementation of every listed extension or catalogue delivery, so those links are kept general or omitted.
